blueprints.name: cut-a-release
blueprints.description: Ship a tagged release: bump versions, regenerate the API schema, tag, and confirm the image published.

nodes.title: Bump manifest versions to {version}
nodes.expected_outcome: every manifest reads {version} and the bump is committed

nodes.title: Regenerate openapi.json
nodes.expected_outcome: openapi.json matches the running app and is committed

nodes.title: Run the full test suite
nodes.expected_outcome: pytest exits 0 on the release commit

blueprints.name: write-a-migration
blueprints.description: Change the schema without losing a production database.

nodes.title: Write the migration by hand
nodes.expected_outcome: a new numbered file exists under scripts/migration

nodes.title: Run it against a copy of production
nodes.expected_outcome: the copy migrates with no errors and row counts match

nodes.title: Record what changed
nodes.expected_outcome: a note names the migration and why it was needed
